paragraph: The Granville composite prints a neutral reading of 50/100 with no active breadth divergence warning, establishing a balanced tactical verdict for the opening bell. Market internals reveal a sharp tug-of-war, as bullish momentum in bellwether semiconductors (SOXX/SPY +1.11%) and subdued volatility (VIX -1.35%) are offset by clear defensive rotation (XLP/XLY +1.07%) and lagging transportation (IYT/SPY -0.46%). Macro conditions echo this split backdrop, featuring a calm spot VIX at 16.82 in steep contango and tight high-yield credit spreads at 2.69%, even as rising 10-year real yields at 2.35% and weak small-cap relative performance (0.3932) cap broader index expansion. Given the direct clash between semiconductor strength and defensive positioning, the directional lean for today's session is neutral-to-slightly bullish, favoring rangebound chop with an upward skew so long as tech leadership remains intact.
